# Map cycles for positions 3, 4, 5

              '598e9cbf8e60024f', '12ee96cc93cd3e0a', '88e45be75860ff8c', 'b4edb3faf810133b'}

all_cycles = {}

# Position 3 (col ~31)
action(['RIGHT'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
pink_hash = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] < 30:
        cr = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        cc = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
        if 50 < cr < 58 and 28 < cc < 35:
            pink_hash = n['hash']
            break

cycle = [pink_hash]
seen = {pink_hash}
for i in range(10):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    new_hash = None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] < 30:
            cr = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
            cc = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
            if 50 < cr < 58 and 28 < cc < 35:
                new_hash = n['hash']
                break
    if new_hash in seen:
        print(f"Pos 3 cycle ({len(cycle)}): {cycle}")
        print(f"  Top-grid symbols: {[h for h in cycle if h in top_hashes]}")
        all_cycles[3] = cycle
        break
    cycle.append(new_hash)
    seen.add(new_hash)

seen = {pink_hash}
for i in range(10):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    new_hash = None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] < 30:
            cr = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
            cc = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])

        break
    cycle.append(new_hash)
    seen.add(new_hash)

# Summary
print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
print("Pos 1 top-grid symbols:", ['cddd7d2c6a6ceea0', 'f4469c244897540c', 'b4edb3faf810133b'])
print("Pos 2 top-grid symbols:", ['fb80c9b281b063da'])
for p in [3, 4, 5]:
    if p in all_cycles:
        tops = [h for h in all_cycles[p] if h in top_hashes]
        print(f"Pos {p} top-grid symbols: {tops}")
